title: Live WSL
description: Aston Villa v Birmingham City (Kick-off 2.00pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Villa Park, as the teams meet in the league for the first time since the 2021/22 campaign. While the Blues claimed a 1-0 win courtesy of Veatriki Sarri on what was the final day of that season, it unfortunately came too late to save them from dropping into the second tier as they had already been relegated prior to kick-off.

title: Live WSL
description: Arsenal v London City Lionesses (Kick-off 4.30pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Emirates Stadium. The visitors will hope to avoid a repeat of the corresponding clash from last season, which saw them thrashed 4-1 in what was their first-ever WSL fixture. Kosovare Asllani gave the debutantes the lead from the penalty spot, but subsequent goals from Olivia Smith, Chloe Kelly, Stina Blackstenius, and Frida Maanum ensured the Gunners were comfortable victors.
